# rollback_evidence

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Executable rollback evidence binding an exact subject to the artifact identity restored by a real rollback transition.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `evidence_id` | `string` | yes | Content-addressed identity of this rollback observation. |
| `subject_sha` | `string` | yes | Exact immutable beam4pm commit verified by this observation. |
| `rollback_digest` | `string` | yes | Digest of the prior artifact restored by the rollback operation. |
| `observed_result` | `atom` | yes | Observed verifier consequence: verified or refused. |
